title: Adnotatiuncula in librum Ruth
author: Hugh of Saint Victor
source_text:
## Adnotatiuncula in librum Ruth

*[n: (RUTH. IV.)] Solvebat homo calceamentum.* Ille homo, qui suo jure cedebat proximo, solvebat calceamentum *suum, et dabat proximo suo* cui cedebat. [0096C] *Hic Booz ergo qui propinquus erat, dixit alteri qui ei cedebat: Tolle calceamentum,* etc.
english:
## A Little Annotation on the Book of Ruth

*[n: (RUTH. IV.)] A man was loosing his sandal.* That man, who was yielding his right to his neighbor, was loosing his sandal *— his own, and was giving it to his neighbor —* to whom he was yielding. [0096C] *This Boaz, then, who was the near kinsman, said to the other who was yielding to him: Take the sandal,* etc.
